name: figments.worker
doc: Run a figments worker in a Kiln fork under the shared figments header (fork + env.sh, kiln gates, foreground runs, no AI attribution, summary). Modes: default, the worker commits on the fork's branch and does not push; pr=true, it also pushes the branch and opens (or updates) a PR against main with gh, never merging; read_only=true, it changes nothing in the fork and writes only the report files its spec names. The worker writes a summary of at most 120 words; it is returned as summary and final. Open: declare other step outputs (pr_url, head_sha, report...) for the worker to submit with step_submit; a submitted head_sha is checked against the fork's HEAD. Engines: opus for judgment work, codex (model sol default, astra for reviews; effort default high) for medium specced work, devin (no model: SWE-2 High) for easy mechanical work.
